text_block_list.text:
It was a total breeze, and I'm running in 
the next race too, so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Maybe it's better to rest after all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"I told you, I'm fine! Let's hurry up and 
get back to training."

It seems that running back-to-back races 
has built up quite a bit of fatigue. We'll 
have to reconsider the upcoming schedule.
